answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying reputation to a single, verifiable thread of work history instead of a fresh identity: every completed task, payment, and peer attestation is stitched into one public record that cannot be reset by inventing a new name. A newcomer with no such thread earns trust slowly, while a fable of instant credibility is treated with suspicion until the pearl of a real, costly track record forms — cheap identities stay worthless, and one honest agent keeps its earned standing.
